questions.question: Why did Ijichi give up on becoming a jujutsu sorcerer?
questions.subject: Kiyotaka Ijichi/Synopsis

answer.item: During his time there, his third-year upperclassman, Satoru Gojo, discouraged him from pursuing a career as a jujutsu sorcerer, instead advising him to get a driver’s license.

questions.question: What did Ijichi discover when Gojo had him research Yuta's background?
questions.subject: Kiyotaka Ijichi/Synopsis

answer.item: Ijichi discovered that Yuta was a descendant of Michizane Sugawara, one of the Big Three Vengeful Spirits and a distant relative of Gojo.

questions.question: What did Ijichi stumble upon when the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons began?
questions.subject: Kiyotaka Ijichi/Synopsis

answer.item: When the battle commenced, Ijichi stumbled upon the bodies of his fellow assistant managers, hanged with nooses.

questions.question: What did Ijichi tell the first-years their mission at the detention center was?
questions.subject: Kiyotaka Ijichi/Synopsis

answer.item: Ijichi emphasized that the mission was to locate and evacuate any survivors, not to engage or exorcise the cursed spirit.

questions.question: What did Ijichi and Gojo witness at the morgue after Yuji was killed?
questions.subject: Kiyotaka Ijichi/Synopsis

answer.item: When Shoko arrived and prepared to dissect Yuji, Ijichi and Gojo watched in shock as the boy suddenly returned to life.

questions.question: How did Ijichi test whether Junpei could see or fight curses?
questions.subject: Kiyotaka Ijichi/Synopsis

answer.item: Ijichi would release caged fly heads to test whether Junpei could see or fight curses.

questions.question: What did Kiyotaka report to the faculty after the Kyoto Goodwill Event invasion?
questions.subject: Kiyotaka Ijichi/Synopsis

answer.item: After the invasion of the Kyoto Goodwill Event is over, Kiyotaka informs the faculty of both college of the casualties and what their prisoner had revealed during a meeting.

questions.question: How was Kiyotaka saved after he was stabbed during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Kiyotaka Ijichi/Synopsis

answer.item: Later, Nanami finds Kiyotaka laying on the ground, wounded and quickly applies medical treatment to save his life and takes him to Shoko for further treatment.

questions.question: Who escorted Tsumiki to the Tokyo No. 1 Colony?
questions.subject: Kiyotaka Ijichi/Synopsis

answer.item: Ijichi escorted Tsumiki to the Tokyo No. 1 Colony with Maki Zenin, unaware of who she was.

questions.question: What did Gojo entrust to Kiyotaka ahead of the fight with Sukuna?
questions.subject: Kiyotaka Ijichi/Synopsis

answer.item: Later on Gojo discussed preparations for the fight with Sukuna entrusting the barrier to Kiyotaka telling he trust the sorcer the most.
